selection_conclusion: Experimental Zig-native Docker Engine integration; no maturity parity with the official Go SDK is established. Search is not an exhaustive proof of absence.

repositories.name: GuangYiL/container-zig
repositories.assessment: Selected for explicit Zig 0.17 branch and typed Docker Engine API. Very limited adoption evidence; one endpoint-helper compatibility patch needed.

repositories.name: nektro/zig-docker
repositories.assessment: Older alternative; published build uses std.build.Builder and std.builtin.Mode. Not a drop-in for the installed compiler; no port or execution performed.

other_candidate.name: eneskemalergin/z-oci
other_candidate.assessment: OCI/Docker Registry API v2 client; different scope from the Docker Engine container-list API.
